newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi to sell $7.66 million GOs on July 16.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi to sell $7.66 million GOs on July 16.

text.p: Mississippi will sell $7.66 million of general obligation bonds by competitive bid at noon EDT on July 16, the State Bond Commission said.
The issue is Mississippi Small Enterprise Development Finance Act Issue, Series 1997 A through H, and has maturities out to 15 years.
Proceeds from the tax-exempt issue will finance business expansion loans to private companies. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
